channel.title: Boekoe Besar: latest case developments
channel.description: The latest developments in Indonesian corruption cases on Boekoe Besar, each one sourced.

item.title: Sudewo: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Railway Project Bribery and Village Official Recruitment Extortion in Pati · PN Tipikor Semarang · 8 years 6 months, a Rp300 million fine or 100 days' detention in lieu, and Rp3.5 billion in restitution. · Source: ANTARA, Bupati Pati Sudewa divonis 8,5 tahun penjara (https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5801841/bupati-pati-sudewa-divonis-85-tahun-penjara)

item.title: Abdul Wahid: Appeal ruling
item.description: Alleged Extortion over Extra Funding for the Riau Public Works Agency · Pengadilan Tinggi Pekanbaru · Sentence raised to 4 years; the Rp200 million fine and Rp1.45 billion restitution stand. · Source: Dandapala (Mahkamah Agung), PT Riau Perberat Hukuman Mantan Gubernur Riau Abdul Wahid Jadi 4 Tahun (https://dandapala.com/article/detail/pt-riau-perberat-hukuman-mantan-gubernur-riau-abdul-wahid-jadi-4-tahun)

item.title: Nadiem Anwar Makarim: Appeal ruling
item.description: Ministry of Education Chromebook Laptop Procurement Corruption · PT DKI Jakarta · Reduced to 9 years; restitution Rp548.76 billion (6 years in lieu); Rp1 billion fine. · Source: Tempo, Bagaimana Hakim Banding Mengubah Vonis Nadiem (https://www.tempo.co/hukum/vonis-banding-nadiem-makarim-chromebook-google-2288907)

item.title: Sudewo: Prosecution demand
item.description: Railway Project Bribery and Village Official Recruitment Extortion in Pati · KPK prosecutors sought 8 years 6 months, a Rp300 million fine or 100 days' detention, restitution, and a 5-year ban from running for office. · Source: ANTARA, Bupati Pati Sudewa dituntut 8,5 tahun (https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5750885/bupati-pati-sudewa-dituntut-85-tahun)

item.title: Maidi: Prosecution demand
item.description: Alleged CSR Extortion and Project-Fee Gratification in Madiun City · KPK prosecutors sought 7 years 2 months, a Rp205 million fine or 90 days' detention, and Rp8 billion in restitution. · Source: ANTARA, Wali Kota Madiun nonaktif Maidi dituntut 7 tahun 2 bulan penjara (https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5746007/wali-kota-madiun-nonaktif-maidi-dituntut-7-tahun-2-bulan-penjara)

item.title: Ade Kuswara Kunang: Political rights revoked
item.description: Advance-Payment Bribery over Bekasi Regency Projects · Right to be elected to public office revoked for 10 years. · Source: Okezone (via RCTI+), Bupati Bekasi Nonaktif Ade Kuswara Divonis 6 Tahun, Hak Politik Dicabut 10 Tahun (https://www.rctiplus.com/news/detail/nasional/5472742/bupati-bekasi-nonaktif-ade-kuswara-divonis-6-tahun--hak-politik-dicabut-10-tahun-)

item.title: Ade Kuswara Kunang: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Advance-Payment Bribery over Bekasi Regency Projects · PN Tipikor Bandung · 6 years and a Rp300 million fine, or 100 days' detention in lieu. · Source: ANTARA, Mendagri berhentikan Ade Kunang sebagai Bupati Bekasi (https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5792201/mendagri-berhentikan-ade-kunang-sebagai-bupati-bekasi)

item.title: Abdul Gafur Mas'ud: Released on parole
item.description: Procurement and Licensing Bribery in Penajam Paser Utara · Paroled from Balikpapan Class IIA prison; must report monthly, with probation expected to run until 2030. According to the prison, the fines (Rp600 million) and restitution (over Rp11 billion) from both cases have been paid. · Source: Kompas.com, Bebas Bersyarat, Mantan Bupati PPU Abdul Gafur Mas'ud Dicabut Hak Politiknya 3 Tahun (https://regional.kompas.com/read/2026/09/01/080923078/bebas-bersyarat-mantan-bupati-ppu-abdul-gafur-masud-dicabut-hak-politiknya)

item.title: Ardito Wijaya: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Bribery and Gratification over Project Fees in Central Lampung · PN Tipikor Tanjung Karang · 5 years, a Rp200 million fine or 8 months' detention in lieu, and Rp7.857 billion in restitution. · Source: Dandapala (Badan Peradilan Umum, Mahkamah Agung), Bupati Lampung Tengah Divonis 5 Tahun Bui dan Uang Pengganti Rp 7,8 M (https://dandapala.com/article/detail/bupati-lampung-tengah-divonis-5-tahun-bui-dan-uang-pengganti-rp-78-m)

item.title: Sugiri Sancoko: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Bribery over Appointments and Hospital Projects in Ponorogo · PN Tipikor Surabaya · 6 years 6 months, a Rp300 million fine and about Rp6.7 billion in restitution. · Source: CNN Indonesia, Bupati Ponorogo Sugiri Divonis 6,5 Tahun di Kasus Suap Jabatan (https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20260814181450-12-1392472/bupati-ponorogo-sugiri-divonis-65-tahun-di-kasus-suap-jabatan)

item.title: Yaqut Cholil Qoumas: On trial
item.description: Alleged Corruption in the Allocation of the Additional 2023-2024 Hajj Quota · PN Tipikor Jakarta Pusat · First hearing; KPK prosecutors read the indictment. · Source: detikNews, Jaksa KPK: Korupsi Kuota Haji Memperkaya Yaqut Rp 4,8 Miliar (https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8613306/jaksa-kpk-korupsi-kuota-haji-memperkaya-yaqut-rp-4-8-miliar)

item.title: Abdul Wahid: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Alleged Extortion over Extra Funding for the Riau Public Works Agency · PN Tipikor Pekanbaru · 2 years, a Rp200 million fine and Rp1.45 billion in restitution. · Source: Kompas.com, Gubernur Nonaktif Riau Abdul Wahid Divonis 2 Tahun Penjara dalam Kasus Dugaan Pemerasan (https://regional.kompas.com/read/2026/07/30/123418978/gubernur-nonaktif-riau-abdul-wahid-divonis-2-tahun-penjara-dalam-kasus?page=all)

item.title: Djuyamto: Cassation ruling
item.description: Bribery for the Release Verdict in the CPO Export Case · Mahkamah Agung · Cassations by the defendant and prosecutors rejected. · Source: detikNews, Kasasi Ditolak, Hakim Djuyamto Tetap Dihukum 12 Tahun Penjara di Kasus Migor (https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8558950/kasasi-ditolak-hakim-djuyamto-tetap-dihukum-12-tahun-penjara-di-kasus-migor)

item.title: Nadiem Anwar Makarim: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Ministry of Education Chromebook Laptop Procurement Corruption · PN Tipikor Jakarta Pusat · 10 years, Rp1 billion fine, about Rp809.6 billion restitution (5 years in lieu). An ad hoc judge dissented. · Source: CNA Indonesia, Nadiem Makarim divonis dalam kasus korupsi Chromebook (https://www.cna.id/indonesia/nadiem-makarim-vonis-chromebook-korupsi-48351)

item.title: Immanuel Ebenezer Gerungan: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Extortion over K3 Certificates at the Ministry of Manpower · PN Tipikor Jakarta Pusat · 4 years 6 months, a Rp200 million fine and Rp3.435 billion in restitution. · Source: ANTARA Kalteng, Noel divonis 4 tahun 6 bulan, terbukti terima gratifikasi (https://kalteng.antaranews.com/berita/829121/noel-divonis-4-tahun-6-bulan-terbukti-terima-gratifikasi)

item.title: Immanuel Ebenezer Gerungan: Final verdict
item.description: Extortion over K3 Certificates at the Ministry of Manpower · No appeal; sent to Sukamiskin prison. · Source: CNN Indonesia, KPK Tak Ajukan Banding Vonis Noel Ebenezer dkk di Kasus Pemerasan K3 (https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20260614141617-12-1369004/kpk-tak-ajukan-banding-vonis-noel-ebenezer-dkk-di-kasus-pemerasan-k3)

item.title: Abdul Azis: Final verdict
item.description: Bribery over the East Kolaka Regional Hospital Project · The defendant did not appeal. · Source: Kabar Kendari, Abdul Azis Terima Vonis, Kasus Korupsi RSUD Kolaka Timur Resmi Inkrah (https://www.kabarkendari.id/abdul-azis-terima-vonis-kasus-korupsi-rsud-kolaka-timur-resmi-inkrah/)

item.title: Nurhadi: Appeal ruling
item.description: Gratification and Money Laundering by the Former Supreme Court Secretary · Pengadilan Tinggi DKI Jakarta · The 5-year sentence was upheld. · Source: ANTARA, PT DKI Jakarta perkuat putusan 5 tahun bui eks Sekretaris MA Nurhadi (https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5579883/pt-dki-jakarta-perkuat-putusan-5-tahun-bui-eks-sekretaris-ma-nurhadi)

item.title: Abdul Azis: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Bribery over the East Kolaka Regional Hospital Project · PN Tipikor Kendari · 4 years 3 months and a Rp250 million fine. · Source: Kendariinfo, Bupati Nonaktif Abdul Azis Divonis Penjara 4 Tahun 3 Bulan di Kasus Korupsi RSUD Koltim (https://kendariinfo.com/bupati-nonaktif-abdul-azis-divonis-penjara-4-tahun-3-bulan-di-kasus-korupsi-rsud-koltim/amp/)

item.title: Nurhadi: Convicted (first instance)
item.description: Gratification and Money Laundering by the Former Supreme Court Secretary · PN Tipikor Jakarta Pusat · 5 years, a Rp500 million fine and Rp137.16 billion in restitution. · Source: detikNews, Eks Sekretaris MA Nurhadi Divonis 5 Tahun Penjara di Kasus Gratifikasi-TPPU (https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8425273/eks-sekretaris-ma-nurhadi-divonis-5-tahun-penjara-di-kasus-gratifikasi-tppu)

item.title: Yaqut Cholil Qoumas: Detained
item.description: Alleged Corruption in the Allocation of the Additional 2023-2024 Hajj Quota · Detained at the KPK detention centre. Briefly moved to house arrest at his family's request, then returned to the KPK detention centre. · Source: ANTARA, KPK limpahkan kasus Yaqut Cholil setelah musim haji 2026 berakhir (https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5589447/kpk-limpahkan-kasus-yaqut-cholil-setelah-musim-haji-2026-berakhir)

item.title: Sudewo: Detained
item.description: Railway Project Bribery and Village Official Recruitment Extortion in Pati · Detained by the KPK for an initial 20 days, 20 January-8 February 2026. · Source: ANTARA, KPK menetapkan Bupati Pati Sudewo tersangka kasus dugaan pemerasan (https://jogja.antaranews.com/berita/797878/kpk-menetapkan-bupati-pati-sudewo-tersangka-kasus-dugaan-pemerasan)

item.title: Sudewo: Suspect
item.description: Railway Project Bribery and Village Official Recruitment Extortion in Pati · Named a suspect in the village official recruitment extortion case with three village heads, after a KPK sting on 19 January 2026. · Source: ANTARA, KPK menetapkan Bupati Pati Sudewo tersangka kasus dugaan pemerasan (https://jogja.antaranews.com/berita/797878/kpk-menetapkan-bupati-pati-sudewo-tersangka-kasus-dugaan-pemerasan)

item.title: Maidi: Suspect
